messages.subject: Get cummulative sums with ddply?
parts:
Is it possible to get cummulative row sums [NT] with ddply.

The example could be

ID Year
A 2000
A 2000
A 2000
A 2008
A 2009
B 2001
B 2001
B 2001
C 2008
C 2009
C 2009
D 2008
D 2009
D 2009

to achieve something like

ID Year N NT
A 2000 3 3
A 2008 1 4
A 2009 1 5
B 2001 3 3
C 2008 1 1
C 2009 2 3
D 2008 1 1
D 2009 2 3

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Get cummulative sums with ddply?
parts:
Just use cumsum:

ddply(df, "ID", transform, NT = cumsum(N))

Hadley

parts:
> This is a two step process isn't?
>
> df <- ddply(tab,c("ID", "Year"),summarise,N=length(ID))
> cum_Sum <- ddply(df, "ID", transform, NT = cumsum(N))
>

Oh sorry, I didn't read your example very closely. Yes, I think you
need two steps, because you are first summarising by both year and ID,
and then just ID.
